literal_meaning: দাঁতে কাঠি বা দড়ি দিয়ে শুয়ে থাকা
figurative_meaning_en: Going to bed without eating; fasting due to hunger
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ অর্থের অভাবে সে দাঁতে কাঠি দিয়ে পড়ে থাকল।
দুর্ভিক্ষের সময় গ্রামের অনেকেই দাঁতে কাঠি দিয়ে পড়ে থাকত।
example_sentences_in_english: Today, due to lack of money, he went to bed hungry.
During the famine, many villagers went to bed without eating.
note: This idiom evokes images of enduring hunger in impoverished settings, possibly originating from traditional practices of self-restraint during scarcity.
